test: harness shell tests > bin/tests/wave-gate-lock-killed.test.sh exits 0 with an empty HOME
reason: Under Git Bash on the loaded GitHub Windows runner the case needs a killed wave-gate's pid to stay dead, and Windows hands the freed pid to a new process within seconds: the next run took it for a live check of the same repository ("another wave-gate check runs in this repository (pid 940)", case "e2e lock of a killed run", PR run 40615971705, 2026-10-28). The case is on its own in harness/bin/tests/wave-gate-lock-killed.test.sh, so the other cases of the e2e lock still run on Windows.
